protocol.comparison_scope: Equal source and hard regional requirements; strategy and explicit suppression permission differ. Fixed baseline receives the same on/off action permission.
protocol.privacy_scope: Operational policy/support compliance only; no attack evaluation or formal anonymity claim.
protocol.recipient_query_scope: No original-GT exact query evaluation for filtered products; report retained detail, source-denominated omissions and full-input semantic distortion.
protocol.source_derivation: Exact [0,end_ms) prefix of the original frozen observations; timestamps/identities/types/positions unchanged. No new motion.

verification.counterexample: 40 exact pedestrians +2 adult +2 child cyclists, support4: reject omitting4/44 because true cyclist family costs2/44.
verification.paired_timing: Exclusive clean serial native window; first potentially contaminated attempt aborted before case1completion and excluded. Single pair/method, no repeated statistical timing claim.

viewer_validation.scope: Original private ownership counts remain unchanged; recipient cells must match approved retained counts and semantics. Structural rejection checks original/retained conservation, occupancy denominator, semantic bin sums, masks, policy cap and full-input benefit. Independent source audit remains separate.
